coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day
Preparing and eating breakfast, drinking coffee
Changing into work uniform and packing work bag with essentials
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, medication rounds, clinical charting and handover to colleagues
Cooking and eating dinner, then clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV to unwind after the shift
Sorting laundry and running the washing machine
Taking a warm shower and completing evening personal hygiene
Using personal computer and phone for messages, planning tomorrow's tasks and winding down
